candidates.change_summary: Store _unlockTime directly instead of the maximum of _unlockTime and block.timestamp, allowing unlockTime to be set in the past.
Ignore the _unlockTime argument and always set unlockTime to block.timestamp.
Delete the deposit statement so the caller's balance is never increased.
Delete the unlockTime update so the stored unlock time is never modified by Put.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so deposits are no longer recorded in the log's History.
Delete the balance-decrease statement so Collect sends funds without debiting the holder's balance.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so successful Collect operations are no longer logged.
Change the unlockTime check from strictly greater to greater-or-equal so withdrawal is allowed at the unlock timestamp.
Change MinSum comparison from >= to > so a balance of exactly MinSum can no longer be collected.
Change the amount check from acc.balance>=_am to acc.balance>_am so withdrawing the entire balance is no longer possible.
Delete the revert on failed send so a failed external call leaves the balance debited without logging or reverting.
Send acc.balance (the full remaining balance) instead of _am to the caller.
